description: Aljal Public Data (알잘 공공데이터): Disposal information by item and local area (시군구): standard garbage bag prices (종량제봉투, also per liter), food waste bag prices, bulky waste collection fees by item (대형폐기물: 소파, 침대, 장롱…), whether an appliance is collected free (폐가전 무상수거, with the official yes/no list for tricky items), and where unused medicine goes (폐의약품). With no inputs: the four kinds. With an item: the rule and the nationwide fee range. With a region: that area's prices and drop-off counts with the page URL. Results are in Korean.

item.description: Optional item in Korean, e.g. "소파", "냉장고", "선풍기", "전동침대", "알약", "주사바늘". 물건.

kind.description: trashbag (종량제봉투 가격), bulkywaste (대형폐기물 수거 비용), ewastebin (폐가전 수거함 · 무상수거), medbin (폐의약품).

place.description: Optional apartment complex name in Korean to check whether an e-waste bin is registered there, e.g. "도곡렉슬". 아파트 단지.

region.description: Optional Korean 시군구 or 시도, e.g. "군포시", "송파구", "부산". 동네.
